verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal lists "webhooks" as part of its Expense API surface, so this is a first-party claim of outbound event callbacks. However, it is a single passing mention: there is no detail on registering endpoints, event types, payloads, signing or retries, and API access is partner-gated. missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription flow, event catalog and payload schemas, delivery guarantees/signature verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow, retrieval and update endpoints across the expense surface, custom-field management, receipts, and webhooks.
